Who will be considered a future All-Star by the end of the NBA season?

I say Hugo Gonzalez from Boston, @GrantLiffmann says Ajay Mitchell from OKC and Anthony Black from Orlando.

Who's on your list?

I'd pick up Walter Clayton ASAP if I were a large number of teams. Both playoff hopefuls and young teams. Only reason Memphis had to cut him was because of the roster crunch. But he showed real flashes as a rookie.

Wild how far Dalton Knecht has fallen after the fast start to his career. Seems like things really turned after the reversed Mark Williams trade. Already 25 years old but he was a late bloomer in college after multiple transfers so maybe that'll happen in the NBA too. We'll see.
